facts.text: Živí se hlavně drobnými hejnovými rybami, někdy i hlavonožci a korýši.
facts.quote: It primarily eats small schooling fish, though may also feed on cephalopods and crustaceans.

facts.text: Hlavními predátory jsou žraloci a velké kostnaté ryby.
facts.quote: Its main predators are sharks such as the dusky shark, and large bony fish.

facts.text: Kořist nejdřív vystopuje, pak vysune čelist a nasaje ji.
facts.quote: The John Dory catches prey by stalking it, then extending its jaw forward in a tube-like structure to suck prey items in.
The eye spot on the flanks also confuses prey, which can then be sucked into its mouth.

facts.text: Dorůstá až 90 cm a váhy 8 kg.
facts.quote: grows to a maximum size of 90 cm (35 in) and a maximum weight of 8 kg (18 lb)

facts.text: Snáší jikry, které se stávají součástí planktonu.
facts.quote: They lay pelagic eggs, which become part of the plankton.
